_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your SQL Server details. config.json is gitignored so credentials never get committed.

llm._comment: LLM Investigation Engine. Leave api_key blank on both slots to get an honest placeholder (no fabricated conclusions). primary is tried first (NVIDIA); secondary is the fallback (Groq) used only if primary isn't configured or its call fails. model is optional — a sensible default is used if blank. Swap the two objects below (or the provider names) to change priority.
